    cin >> x >> y >> n;

    LL bestRem = (1LL << 32);

        for (int j = 0; j < 20; ++j) {

                    bestRem = diff;

                }
            }
        }
    }

    cout << bestNum << "/" << bestDen << endl;
    return 0;
